summary.text: Ken Fleming is a Republican state representative from Kentucky who has represented District 48 since 2021 and is seeking re-election to the Kentucky House of Representatives in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Fleming is a nonprofit executive by profession.

paragraphs.text: Ken Fleming earned a B.B.A. from the University of Kentucky.
His career experience includes working as president of the Management Association for Private Photogrammetric Surveyors and as executive director of Kilgore Samaritan Counseling Center.
Fleming served on the Louisville Metro Council for District 7 from 2003 to 2015 and held the Kentucky House District 48 seat from 2017 to 2019, before returning to it in January 2021.
In the 2025-2026 session Fleming was assigned to the House Appropriations and Revenue, Health and Family Services, Primary and Secondary Education, and Local Government committees.
